// executeSwitchPTEffect - "Switch <scope> creature's power and toughness until
// end of turn" (Rule 613.4e). It registers the already-accepted Layer 7e
// representation (ContinuousEffect.SwitchPT, applied by Card.ptWithEffects via
// EffectManager.ShouldSwitchPT) with UntilEOT true, and contains NO P/T layer
// logic of its own. Deliberately never snapshots SetPower/SetToughness: that
// would freeze the pre-bonus values in Layer 7b (a 2/5 with +1/+2 must end up
// 7/3, not 8/5), and removal (RemoveUntilEOT/RemoveBySource/RemoveByID) then
// restores the unswitched values with no cleanup bookkeeping.
//
// Exactly the three pre-proven scopes are supported, using the existing target
// and battlefield mechanisms only:
//   - self          — no targets: the source switches its own P/T
//   - target        — one or more card targets ("switch target creature's ...")
//   - each          — {target:"each"} with the same optional controller scope
//     spelling executePutCounterEffect reads ("" / "any" = every creature)
//
// Noncreature and non-card (player) target entries are skipped, leaving every
// other permanent untouched.
func (gs *GameState) executeSwitchPTEffect(controller int, source *Card, effectValue map[string]interface{}, targets []Target) error {
	register := func(card *Card) {
		if card == nil || !card.IsCreature() {
			return
		}
		gs.EffectManager.Register(&ContinuousEffect{
			Source:          source,
			AffectsSpecific: card.ID,
			SwitchPT:        true,
			UntilEOT:        true,
		})
	}

	if getStringValue(effectValue, "target", "") == "each" {
		scope := getStringValue(effectValue, "controller", "")
		for _, c := range gs.Battlefield.GetAll() {
			switch scope {
			case "you":
				if c.Controller != controller {
					continue
				}
			case "opponent":
				if c.Controller == controller {
					continue
				}
			}
			register(c)
		}
		return nil
	}

	if len(targets) == 0 {
		register(source)
		return nil
	}

	for _, target := range targets {
		if !target.IsCard {
			continue
		}
		card, err := gs.Battlefield.GetCard(target.CardID)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		register(card)
	}

	return nil
}

package game

// ticket:engine.switch-pt/v2 behavior tests for the switch_pt ability-effect
// executor. These drive the real dispatch (ExecuteAbilityEffect) rather than
// the executor directly, and assert through the computed P/T getters so the
// Layer 7e swap is proven to run AFTER the Layer 7c additive bonus: a 2/5 with
// a +1/+2 (computed 3/7) must switch to 7/3, and end-of-turn removal of the
// UntilEOT switch must restore the normal computed 3/7 — which a
// SetPower/SetToughness snapshot could not do.

import "testing"

func switchPTComputed(gs *GameState, c *Card) (int, int) {
	return c.GetPowerWithEffects(gs.EffectManager), c.GetToughnessWithEffects(gs.EffectManager)
}

func TestSwitchPTExecutionTargetCreature(t *testing.T) {
	gs := NewGame("P0", "P1", false)

	ox := NewCreature("Switch Test Ox", ManaCost{}, 2, 5, 1)
	ox.Owner, ox.Controller = 0, 0
	gs.Battlefield.AddCard(ox)

	src := NewCreature("Switch Test Source", ManaCost{}, 1, 1, 1)
	src.Owner, src.Controller = 0, 0
	gs.Battlefield.AddCard(src)

	// A non-UntilEOT +1/+2 (Layer 7c) so the NORMAL computed P/T is 3/7 and
	// survives the end-of-turn cleanup below.
	gs.EffectManager.Register(&ContinuousEffect{
		Source:          src,
		AffectsSpecific: ox.ID,
		PowerMod:        1,
		ToughnessMod:    2,
	})
	if p, tg := switchPTComputed(gs, ox); p != 3 || tg != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("pre-switch computed P/T = %d/%d, want 3/7", p, tg)
	}

	if err := gs.ExecuteAbilityEffect("switch_pt", 0, src, map[string]interface{}{},
		[]Target{{IsCard: true, CardID: ox.ID}}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ExecuteAbilityEffect(switch_pt): %v", err)
	}
	if p, tg := switchPTComputed(gs, ox); p != 7 || tg != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("switched P/T = %d/%d, want 7/3 (post-additive Layer 7e swap)", p, tg)
	}

	gs.EffectManager.RemoveUntilEOT()
	if p, tg := switchPTComputed(gs, ox); p != 3 || tg != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("post-cleanup P/T = %d/%d, want the normal computed 3/7", p, tg)
	}
}

func TestSwitchPTExecutionSelfNoTargets(t *testing.T) {
	gs := NewGame("P0", "P1", false)

	src := NewCreature("Switch Test Thaumaturgist", ManaCost{}, 2, 5, 1)
	src.Owner, src.Controller = 0, 0
	gs.Battlefield.AddCard(src)

	other := NewCreature("Switch Test Bystander", ManaCost{}, 1, 4, 1)
	other.Owner, other.Controller = 1, 1
	gs.Battlefield.AddCard(other)

	if err := gs.ExecuteAbilityEffect("switch_pt", 0, src, map[string]interface{}{}, nil); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ExecuteAbilityEffect(switch_pt, self): %v", err)
	}
	if p, tg := switchPTComputed(gs, src); p != 5 || tg != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("self-switched P/T = %d/%d, want 5/2", p, tg)
	}
	if p, tg := switchPTComputed(gs, other); p != 1 || tg != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("bystander P/T = %d/%d, want an untouched 1/4", p, tg)
	}

	gs.EffectManager.RemoveUntilEOT()
	if p, tg := switchPTComputed(gs, src); p != 2 || tg != 5 {
		t.Fatalf("post-cleanup self P/T = %d/%d, want 2/5", p, tg)
	}
}

func TestSwitchPTExecutionEachCreatureIgnoresNoncard(t *testing.T) {
	gs := NewGame("P0", "P1", false)

	src := NewCreature("Switch Test Broadcaster", ManaCost{}, 1, 1, 1)
	src.Owner, src.Controller = 0, 0
	gs.Battlefield.AddCard(src)

	mine := NewCreature("Switch Test Mine", ManaCost{}, 2, 5, 1)
	mine.Owner, mine.Controller = 0, 0
	gs.Battlefield.AddCard(mine)

	theirs := NewCreature("Switch Test Theirs", ManaCost{}, 0, 3, 1)
	theirs.Owner, theirs.Controller = 1, 1
	gs.Battlefield.AddCard(theirs)

	// A player target entry must be ignored without touching any permanent.
	if err := gs.ExecuteAbilityEffect("switch_pt", 0, src,
		map[string]interface{}{"target": "each"},
		[]Target{{IsCard: false, PlayerIdx: 1}}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ExecuteAbilityEffect(switch_pt, each): %v", err)
	}
	if p, tg := switchPTComputed(gs, mine); p != 5 || tg != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("each-scope own creature P/T = %d/%d, want 5/2", p, tg)
	}
	if p, tg := switchPTComputed(gs, theirs); p != 3 || tg != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("each-scope opposing creature P/T = %d/%d, want 3/0", p, tg)
	}

	gs.EffectManager.RemoveUntilEOT()
	if p, tg := switchPTComputed(gs, mine); p != 2 || tg != 5 {
		t.Fatalf("post-cleanup P/T = %d/%d, want 2/5", p, tg)
	}
}
